# CORE-CST-01

**Is the running cost modelled, with a unit cost and a budget?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | CST: Cost and sustainability |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | design.type is reference-architecture or solution-design |
| Reads | `operations.cost`, `evidence.type` |

## Why it matters

R4 Buildable needs a cost model on the realising reference architecture.

## Rule

evidence has an entry of type cost-model, and operations.cost has unit_cost and budget. A sentence in operations.cost.model describing how cost will be modelled is not a cost model, and does not meet this criterion.
